items.title_orig: Looking at Most Streamed Songs - Getting Surprised?
items.article_text:
For fun I like to look up which songs are the most streamed for certain artists. Some of the results are surprising. For example:
 - Here Comes the Sun is by far the most streamed Beatles song; almost double the next closest Beatles song (Come Together).
 - Can’t Stop is the Red Hot Chili Pepper’s 3rd most streamed song (even though it was left off their greatest hits album).
 - Nirvana has double the total streams as Pearl Jam, even though they were peers in sales during the 90s.
 Anybody else find some interesting stats looking up streaming data? Feel free to share!
